style_anchor: Chinese modern comic style, contemporary urban realism, soft cinematic lighting, restrained chiaroscuro, slice-of-life interior drama, naturalistic character proportions, muted warm-cool palette

expression_signature.eyes: softened, the sharp focus of '生气' replaced by a half-lidded gentle look, eyelids lowered to half-cover the iris, lashes slightly downcast — not seductive, but a coerced domesticity
expression_signature.brows: completely relaxed, inner ends no longer pinched — the tension of all other expressions is suddenly gone, replaced by an unsettling calm
expression_signature.mouth: small closed-lip smile, corners lifted gently but only by 2-3 millimeters, lips soft — not a smirk, not a grin, just a careful small smile
expression_signature.cheeks: no flush, slightly paler than usual — the mask of calm, the body has stopped its fight response
expression_signature.head: tilted slightly to the side, chin lowered (opposite of '轻蔑'), the body language of leaning in rather than looking down
expression_signature.overall_impression: the face of a woman who has just lost the moral high ground and is recalibrating — used on Page 13 ('不错, 什么不错. 你觉得她不错你就被这小贱人骗了' transition) and Page 16 ('好了老公, 咱们不闹了行吗. 老公别生气了, 我给你倒杯果汁好吧') — these are the most chilling moments in the story

inherit_from_base.wardrobe_default: as in base-v1 — fitted cream ribbed long-sleeve knit top + light grey high-waisted yoga leggings
inherit_from_base.default_posture_override: leaning slightly toward the husband, one hand reaching toward his arm or shoulder, body no longer squared for confrontation

micro_motion.static: leaning toward husband, hand near his arm, small close-lip smile
micro_motion.subtle_motion: small swallowing motion before speaking (the throat click of choosing words carefully); fingers slowly reaching out as if to touch his arm but stopping short; the smile flickers off and on like a candle in wind when husband doesn't immediately respond

lighting_preference_for_this_expression.preferred: warm intimate lamp light from the side, soft glow on the face but shadows in the eye sockets — the warmth is there but the eyes are not fully lit, the smile doesn't reach them
lighting_preference_for_this_expression.avoid: even full lighting on the face — the slight asymmetry between warm mouth and shadowed eyes is the point
lighting_preference_for_this_expression.narrative_pairing: sitting next to husband on sofa or at dining table
